# DAS Digital

> DAS Digital helps small businesses with website design, AI receptionists, business automation and technology consulting. Based in West Palm Beach, Florida, serving Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade counties. Founded in 1989 as DAS Consulting Services by David Spatz.

- Phone: (954) 673-3041
- Email: info@dasdigitalai.com
- Website: https://dasdigitalai.com
- AI receptionists can answer callers in English or Spanish.
- Plain-language help for owners of local businesses such as HVAC companies, plumbers, electricians, roofers, landscapers, restaurants and shops.

## Services

- [Website Design](https://dasdigitalai.com/website-design): fast, phone-friendly small business websites that make it easy to call, book and find the business on Google.
- [Online Store Setup](https://dasdigitalai.com/online-store): online stores for small businesses with card checkout, shipping or pickup, and order alerts; offered as the Online Store Starter Package.
- [AI Receptionists](https://dasdigitalai.com/ai-receptionist): answers calls 24/7, takes the caller's details, flags urgent calls and texts the owner right away.
- [Business Automation](https://dasdigitalai.com/ai-automation-small-business): automatic follow-ups, reminders, lead tracking, texts and payment links.
- [Technology Consulting](https://dasdigitalai.com/technology-consulting): straight advice on which software, phone and point-of-sale tools to keep, replace or connect.
- [Automation and AI consultant in Florida](https://dasdigitalai.com/automation-consultant-florida): local help for South Florida businesses.
- [Custom SaaS development](https://dasdigitalai.com/custom-saas-development): vertical software for small industries.
- [Sales tools for merchant services teams](https://dasdigitalai.com/merchant-services-sales-tools)

## By trade

- [Automation by trade](https://dasdigitalai.com/automation): HVAC companies, plumbers, electricians, roofers, landscapers and boutiques.
